Order No. 03 Dated 03rd December, 2025
I.A. No. 9467 of 2025
Heard the learned counsel for the respective parties.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences u/s 363, 376-DA and 506 of the IPC and Sections 4, 6 and 8 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for life which shall mean the remainder of his natural life along with a fine of Rs. 50,000/- for the offence u/s 376-DA of the IPC.
It has been alleged that the daughter of the victim went missing from his house on 26.12.2019 and thereafter on 28.12.2019 his daughter returned back and on enquiry disclosed that the present appellant and another co- convict had committed rape upon her.
Though it has been submitted by Mr. Mahatha, learned counsel for the appellant particularly putting stress on the chronological events which according to him clearly demolish the case of the prosecution, but regard being had to the evidence of the victim who has been examined as PW-1 as well as the medical report which supports the factum of rape committed upon the victim, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the appellant is hereby rejected.
